messages:
Tara Nguyen: quick sync 1 post-launch pulse: we have 2 P0s (signup race, billing double-charge), 9 low-ux bugs, and 3 customer enhancement asks. can we agree on a compact plan?
Ibrahim Khan: my take 1 run a 4-day bug sprint with a tiny "invest" lane (1 engineer) for a gated enhancement. keeps momentum without spreading focus.
Sofia Martin: +1. Need clear acceptance criteria for the enhancements before they enter the invest lane. otherwise they balloon.
Ethan Park: ops note 1 signup race looks like a distributed lock gap under burst load. i can push a mitigation toggle that reduces contention; needs a canary and a short DB migration window.
Tara Nguyen: proposal:
- Mon-Thu: stability sprint (hotfix lane for customer-tied regressions)
- Fri: ship one behind-flag enhancement (if safety gates pass) + retro
Gates to close sprint: no unresolved P0s, smoke tests green, p99 within baseline *1.10.
Sofia Martin: enhancement acceptance template I'll use: 1) customer problem statement, 2) success metric + SLA impact, 3) test plan + telemetry events, 4) rollback plan. will post as a tiny doc.
Ibrahim Khan: backlog grooming rule: if feature doesn't show clear customer ROI or <2 engineers and <5 story-points, it goes into the invest lane. anything bigger needs RFC & PM sign-off.
Ethan Park: quick rollout checklist for hotfixes:
```
- create 5% canary
- run smoke + perf suite
- monitor errors and p99
- automatic rollback if error-rate > baseline*2 or p99 > baseline*1.15
```
Tara Nguyen: owners: Tara -> customer comms and priority tradeoffs; Ethan -> hotfix canary + mitigation toggle; Sofia -> enhancement acceptance + flag test plan; Ibrahim -> sprint prioritization + QA assignments.
LaunchBot: Created calendar event: "Compact post-launch stability sprint" Mon 09:30 PT - Thu 10:00 PT.
Sofia Martin: action items: i'll post the acceptance template + tag owners by EOD. if enhancement meets gates, i'll schedule feature flag rollout on Fri with a 24h observation window.
Ibrahim Khan: will assign hotfix owner in the board and mark p0s with "urgent" label. please ping here with any new regressions.
Tara Nguyen: thanks team. short updates preferred in this thread. we'll use Fri retro to decide whether to continue with mixed sprints or alternate bug-only weeks. :thumbsup:
